scenes.caption: Sunrise.
scenes.say: Zainab sees the Sun rise in the east.

scenes.caption: A star.
scenes.say: The Sun is a star. It gives us light and heat.

scenes.caption: Earth spins.
scenes.say: Earth spins slowly. That is why we have day and night.

scenes.caption: Sunset.
scenes.say: In the evening the Sun sets in the west.

scenes.caption: Night.
scenes.say: Now our side of Earth faces away from the Sun.

scenes.caption: The Moon.
scenes.say: The Moon does not make light. It reflects the Sun's light.

scenes.caption: A crescent.
scenes.say: Her family looks for the new crescent at the end of the month.

scenes.caption: A new month.
scenes.say: The crescent shows that a new Islamic month has begun.
